_comment: U7 LG1 (docs/specs/ATP_LEGENDS_SCREENS_ADDENDUM.md §1 'Source discipline'): the public sources the Legends cards cite. Every line of a card names at least one id here, and app/screener/legends.py refuses a card that cites anything else. Only published, publicly available works (books, papers); no paywalled course material, no private notes, no hearsay. English only. Bibliographic details are the first editions as public catalogues record them (LG1-2): 'review' is 'verified' when title, authors, first-edition year and publisher were checked against the catalogue / ISBN records in 'evidence' (each a public URL), and 'unverified' with a 'review_note' saying what is unsettled. This is a bibliographic check only; the owner's legal review of the card texts against copies of the books (spec §1, before Phase 1) is separate.

sources.title: Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard: How to Achieve Super Performance in Stocks in Any Market
sources.covers: The trend template: price and moving-average order (50, 150, 200-day), a rising 200-day average, distance from the 52-week high and low, and a relative-strength ranking.
sources.review_note: WorldCat OCLC 850605831: McGraw-Hill Education, New York, 2013 (ISBN 9780071807227, LCCN 2013005165).

sources.title: How I Made $2,000,000 in the Stock Market
sources.covers: The box theory: rising stocks moving through a series of price boxes, action only when price leaves the top of the latest box, attention to volume, and the author's background as a professional dancer.
sources.review_note: Internet Archive catalogue record: Larchmont, N.Y., American Research Council, 1960, 178 p.; Lyle Stuart editions followed. Library of Congress name authority: ballroom dancer who began investing in 1952.

sources.title: Stan Weinstein's Secrets for Profiting in Bull and Bear Markets
sources.covers: Stage analysis on weekly charts: four stages (basing, advancing, top, declining), the 30-week moving average, the stage 2 breakout above resistance with expanding volume, and relative strength.
sources.review_note: WorldCat and Open Library: Dow Jones-Irwin, Homewood, Ill., 1988 (ISBN 1556230796; LC HG4910 .W363 1988).

sources.title: Way of the Turtle: The Secret Methods that Turned Ordinary People into Legendary Traders
sources.covers: The Turtle program run by Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt, and its rules: channel breakouts of 20 days (System 1) and 55 days (System 2), volatility (N, an average true range) for position size and stops, futures markets.
sources.review_note: WorldCat OCLC 154806327 and Internet Archive: McGraw-Hill, New York, 2007 (ISBN 9780071486644).

sources.title: The Complete TurtleTrader: The Legend, the Lessons, the Results
sources.covers: The history of the Turtle program (Richard Dennis, William Eckhardt, the traders they trained in the 1980s) and its breakout rules.
sources.review_note: WorldCat OCLC 145379622: Collins (HarperCollins imprint), New York, 2007, 1st ed. (ISBN 9780061241703).

sources.title: Street Smarts: High Probability Short-Term Trading Strategies
sources.covers: Short-term setups, including the ADX pullback to the 20-period exponential moving average (14-period ADX above 30 marking a strong trend, entry trigger above the high of the pullback bar).
sources.review_note: WorldCat OCLC 36390149: M. Gordon Pub. Group, Malibu, Calif., 1995 (ISBN 0965046109). Open Library shows a 1996 date for the same ISBN; the catalogue's 1995 copyright date is kept.

sources.title: Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and Opening Range Breakout
sources.covers: Statistical study of short-term price patterns: range contraction (narrow-range days such as NR4 and NR7, inside days) and the opening-range breakout.
sources.review_note: WorldCat OCLC 23103747 and Open Library: Traders Press, Greenville, S.C., 1990 (ISBN 0934380171).

sources.title: Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
sources.covers: Short-term pullbacks within long-term uptrends: price above the 200-day moving average and the 2-period RSI at low (oversold) readings, with several thresholds examined.
sources.review_note: First-edition year unsettled: Google Books lists TradingMarkets Publishing Group, 2008; Open Library (OCLC 428113377) lists 2009, and a copyright line of 2009 is reported. Kept at 2008 until checked against a copy's copyright page.

sources.title: Long-Term Secrets to Short-Term Trading
sources.covers: Short-term trading and volatility breakouts: a move from the open by a percentage of the previous day's range.
sources.review_note: Open Library (LC record) and the publisher's catalogue page: John Wiley & Sons, 1999, Wiley Trading Advantage series (ISBN 0471297224); catalogued as Larry R. Williams.
